scenario: Unary `~` is bitwise not; integers only per LEXP.7.9. Applying `~` to a Float-typed slot is a compile-time error. Pin: `where ~t.f > 0` on a Float slot rejects with a static-type-mismatch diagnostic. Mirror of the binary-bitwise rejection at LEXP.7.7.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    f: Float key

rule r:
    Trig t where ~t.f > 0
->
    log info "x"
